arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_PAGER=cat PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
checkout=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-leads-release-qa.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$checkout"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$checkout/source"
test "$(git -C "$checkout/source" rev-parse HEAD)" = 9596a0687aeed20e03bcd1f91ae2ad6d830cd523
echo VERIFIED_RELEASE_SHA=9596a0687aeed20e03bcd1f91ae2ad6d830cd523
cd "$checkout/source"
sudo -n env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests > "$checkout/test-output.txt" 2>&1 || { tail -n 25 "$checkout/test-output.txt"; exit 7; }
tail -n 7 "$checkout/test-output.txt"
echo TESTS_ON_VPS_PASSED
echo ACTIVE_INSTALLATION_NOT_MODIFIED
